'''''Prospero autumnale''''', the '''autumn squill''', an autumnal flowering plant of the family [[Asparagaceae]], subfamily [[Scilloideae]], is found in the [[Mediterranean]] region from [[Portugal]] and [[Morocco]] east to [[Turkey]] and the [[Caucasus]], plus [[Great Britain]].<ref name="WCSP">[http://apps.kew.org/wcsp/namedetail.do?name_id=285270 Kew World Checklist of Selected Plant Families]</ref><ref>[http://luirig.altervista.org/flora/taxa/index1.php?scientific-name=prospero+autumnale Altervista Flora Italiana, Scilla autunnale, Autumn Squill, ''Prospero autumnale'']</ref><ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.herbarium.rdg.ac.uk/mediplants/resultd.asp?SP=Prospero%20autumnale |title=Mediterranean Plants Identification |access-date=2010-02-13 |archive-date=2012-02-20 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120220134113/http://www.herbarium.rdg.ac.uk/mediplants/resultd.asp?SP=Prospero%20autumnale |url-status=dead }}</ref> Despite being classified as a single species, it is actually a [[cryptic species complex]], with a variety of cytotypes having been discovered which are [[Phenotype|phenotypically]] indistinguishable from each other.<ref>{{cite journal | doi = 10.1038/hdy.1991.92 | last1 = Parker | first1 = J. S. | last2 = Lozano | year = 1991 | first2 = R | last3 = Taylor | first3 = S | last4 = Rejón | first4 = M Ruiz | title = Chromosomal structure of populations of ''Scilla autumnalis'' in the Iberian Peninsula | journal = Heredity | volume = 67 | issue = 3| pages = 287–97 | bibcode = 1991Hered..67..287P | doi-access = free }}</ref>
